name: New product / go-to-market (4Ps)
summary: Should we launch, and how? Validate the customer need and market, check the economics, then design the launch with the 4Ps (product, price, place, promotion) and a plan for risks such as cannibalisation.
opening_line: I'd first confirm there's a real customer need and a big enough market, then check the product economics, and finally lay out the go-to-market plan: product, price, channels and promotion.
when_to_use: Launching a new product or service
Designing a go-to-market or commercialisation plan
Expanding an existing product to new customers or channels
when_not_to_use: Entering a new geography with an existing product: use market entry
An existing product losing money: use profitability

buckets.name: Customer & market
questions: Who is the customer, and what problem does it solve?

buckets.name: Economics
questions: What price and volume, and when do we break even?
How much will it cannibalise existing products?
